title: 第17章 暗门第18章 开启的仪式

第十七章暗门(第二更)
“郝宁击杀20级幽灵骑士（精英），获得600经验值！”
失去支撑的郝宁陡然跌倒在地上，他贪婪地呼吸着潮湿而且带着腐臭的空气，他想不到自己竟然能够杀死这个亡灵生物。
看着状态栏上的经验值，郝宁毫不犹豫地点击了升级！
虽然看不到每次升级需要的上限，但这次需要的经验值似乎上次还要多，600多经验只将郝宁提升了2级。
但这次郝宁没有急着将这4点潜力点数加上去，而是把它先放着，因为他感觉现在自己盲目加点似乎不太好。
“恭喜你能够活下来，但我们要尽快前往暗门……因为你刚刚使用的那件东西，有更多的邪恶生物在搜索着我们。”
这时候黛西的声音出现在郝宁脑海中，同时也驱散了他脑袋中的睡意，现在可不是睡觉的时候，杀死了幽灵骑士说不定维德诺牧师正在往这边过来呢。
“知道了，接下来该怎么走！”
郝宁用手中长剑将自己的身体撑起来，跄踉地往前走去。
郝宁并不敢点燃火把，生怕会引来什么亡灵生物，他在昏暗的通道中走了大概十多分钟，忽然黛西修女让他停了下来。
“停下来吧，我们到了。”
可是郝宁不禁感到疑惑，在他面前明明还有长长的一截路，四周也没有任何东西，怎么会已经回到了所谓的暗门？
忽然间黛西修女从郝宁身体中浮现出来，也不说话，只是对着一旁的墙壁吟唱起神秘的咒语。
不得不说黛西的声音非常好听，如果她唱歌的话一定会比前世那些歌星唱的还要好听。
忽然郝宁看着黛西修女，心中顿时感到气血翻腾，因为眼前黛西身上的衣服竟然破破烂烂，露出里面白嫩细滑的肌肤，一个穿着破烂修女服的女人站在面前，几乎让郝宁把持不住。
尤其是黛西那双修长美腿，顿时让郝宁遐想连篇，在他心中已经幻想着黛西穿上黑丝的情景。
“轰隆！”
一阵轰鸣过后，平整的墙壁上竟然出现了一道门。
“你不要进去吗？”

忽然黛西的声音将郝宁从幻想中拉了回来，他连忙装作严肃地咳嗽两声，随即往通道内走去，同时他也在观察着里面，原来这就是暗门，隐约间好像看到里面有光，难道有人在里面？
忽然他在经过黛西身边的时候，透过黛西破烂的衣服竟然看到了里面的两颗粉红樱桃。
此时就算脸皮再厚的郝宁也不禁弯着身子往前走，双手有意无意地遮掩着裤裆上的帐篷。
“混蛋！”黛西不由恼怒地暗骂一声，她生前什么时候被人这样肆无忌惮地望过，现在竟然被这个家伙几乎看光了身体。
她双手忍不住去遮掩一下重要部位，不过这样做效果只是让郝宁扫描她身体的次数更加频繁。
她心中骂了几句郝宁后，便紧随其后进入了暗门。
当他们两人一同走进暗门后，那道墙壁竟然自动恢复原状，没有丝毫亮光的通道也恢复平静。
走进暗门后郝宁发现自己来到了一个巨大密室，墙壁上每个一米都会有一盏油灯，这样使整个密室都保持着良好的能见度，而且根据郝宁目测，这个密室有前世足球场那么大。
忽然郝宁看到了密室中心竟然有一个巨大的黑色箱子，那不就是他为了躲避维德诺与一个神秘人的时候，所藏进去的箱子吗？
“黛西修女，你的尸……身体好像就在那个箱子里面！”郝宁神情凝重地指着那边的黑色箱子说道，从看到黑色箱子那一刻开始，他就感到空气中蔓延着诡异的气息。
“不可能！里面的不可能是我的身体！”
“我的身体早就被毁掉了，在韦伯利子爵来到菲尼斯的时候，已经被维德诺牧师给毁掉了，只是他想不到我的灵魂还存在。”
黛西修女一副看神经病的眼神望着郝宁，她脸上的表情仿佛在说着你别想骗我。
“你在说谎，那天晚上我还在教堂后的墓园看到你！……引我来这里，你有什么目的！”
顿时郝宁心中涌现出无尽的疑惑，他不确定黛西有没有在说谎。
如果说黛西没有说谎，那么他所看到的尸体究竟是谁？而且韦伯利来到菲尼斯的时候，距离郝宁被抓进监狱整整有半年的时间。
那么他在被抓前的晚上，所看到的黛西修女又是谁！
“你不相信我？随你吧，我们逃出去的方法就在这间密室的中心，走不走随你！”
黛西的脸色彻底阴沉了下来，说完后头也不回得向着密室的中心，也就是那个箱子的位置走去。
整个密室只剩下数万盏油灯燃烧的声音，郝宁神情复杂地跟上黛西的脚步，他没有选择，一是留下来等死，另一个选择就是选择跟随黛西。

既然都走到这了，他是不可能退缩的，身后就是聚集着无数亡灵升生物的地牢！
“黛西，想不到你还没死啊！而且那只小老鼠似乎也跟着到这里来了！”
就在这时候，密室的角落中竟然传来了维德诺牧师的声音。
昏暗的角落中一团黑影浮现，渐渐幻化出维德诺牧师的模样，身穿着洁白的牧师袍，他的脸上更是挂着慈祥老人般的笑容。
忽然郝宁听到空气中传来的震动与轻微的呼啸声，那就像是箭矢上的尾翼震动所发出的声音，刹那间他的眼睛捕捉到角落中一道黑光朝着黛西激射而去。
“趴下！”郝宁猛然一扑，将还在错愕状态下的黛西扑倒在地。
幸好黛西的灵魂状态能够触碰得到，不然郝宁真的救不了她，直觉告诉他那道箭矢并不简单！
他回头望去，只见身后一支箭矢深深没入地面！
“维德诺，你不是说那个修女已经死了吗？现在她的灵魂就在我眼前，你确定这样子对我们的计划没有影响？”
一个手持长弓的身影在维德诺身边浮现，郝宁仔细一看，发现那就是自己任务的目标韦伯利子爵！他们果然同流合污，郝宁藏在箱子中那时候所看到的另外一个人应该就是他了。
“韦伯利，你放心，事情会顺利的！解决他们用不着你出手！”维德诺微微一笑，对着韦伯利笑呵呵地说道。
这一切郝宁都看在眼里，他们究竟是什么关系？他感觉维德诺牧师似乎对韦伯利有些顾忌，不，更应该说是敬畏！
忽然他的耳边传来黛西羞怒的声音：“你该从我身上起来了！”
content_en:
Chapter 17 Secret Door (Second Update)
"Hao Ning killed the level 20 ghost knight (elite) and gained 600 experience points!"
Hao Ning lost his support and suddenly fell to the ground. He greedily breathed in the moist and rancid air. He never thought that he could kill this undead creature.
Looking at the experience points on the status bar, Hao Ning clicked to upgrade without hesitation!
Although I can't see the upper limit required for each upgrade, it seems that the experience points required this time are even more than last time. More than 600 experience points only upgraded Hao Ning by 2 levels.
But this time Hao Ning did not rush to add these 4 potential points, but put them aside because he felt that it was not good to blindly add points now.
"Congratulations on your ability to survive, but we have to go to the secret door as soon as possible...because of the thing you just used, there are more evil creatures searching for us."
At this time, Daisy's voice appeared in Hao Ning's mind, and it also dispelled the sleepiness in his head. Now was not the time to sleep. After killing the Ghost Rider, maybe Pastor Vidno was coming this way.
"I know, what to do next!"
Hao Ning used the long sword in his hand to prop up his body and staggered forward.
Hao Ning did not dare to light the torch for fear that it would attract some undead creatures. He walked in the dim passage for about ten minutes when Sister Daisy suddenly asked him to stop.
"Stop it, we're here."
But Hao Ning couldn't help but wonder. There was still a long road in front of him, and there was nothing around him. How could he have returned to the so-called secret door?
Suddenly, Sister Daisy emerged from Hao Ning's body. She didn't speak, but chanted a mysterious spell to the wall nearby.
I have to say that Daisy's voice is very beautiful. If she sings, it will be even better than those singers in her previous life.
Suddenly, Hao Ning looked at Sister Daisy and felt her blood surge in her heart. Because the clothes on Daisy's body were in tatters, revealing her fair and smooth skin. A woman wearing a tattered nun's uniform stood in front of her, which almost made Hao Ning uncontrollable.
Especially Daisy's long and beautiful legs, which immediately made Hao Ning daydream about it. In his mind, he had already imagined Daisy wearing black stockings.
"Boom!"
After a roar, a door appeared on the flat wall.
"Don't you want to go in?"
Suddenly Daisy's voice pulled Hao Ning back from his fantasy. He quickly pretended to be serious and coughed twice, then walked into the passage. At the same time, he was also observing inside. It turned out that this was a secret door. He seemed to see a light inside vaguely. Could someone be inside?
Suddenly, when he passed by Daisy, he saw two pink cherries inside Daisy's tattered clothes.
At this time, even the thick-skinned Hao Ning couldn't help but bend forward and move forward, covering the tent on his crotch with his hands intentionally or unintentionally.
"Asshole!" Daisy couldn't help but cursed in anger. She had never been looked at so unscrupulously before her death, and now she was almost naked by this guy.
She couldn't help but use her hands to cover important parts, but the effect of doing so was only to make Hao Ning scan her body more frequently.
After scolding Hao Ning a few times in her mind, she followed him into the secret door.
When the two of them walked into the secret door together, the wall automatically returned to its original state, and the passage without any light returned to calm.
After walking through the secret door, Hao Ning found himself in a huge secret room. There was an oil lamp every meter on the wall, which kept the entire secret room with good visibility. According to Hao Ning's visual inspection, this secret room was as big as a football field in his previous life.
Suddenly, Hao Ning saw a huge black box in the center of the secret room. Wasn't that the box he hid in to avoid Vidno and a mysterious man?
"Sister Daisy, your body...The body seems to be inside that box! Hao Ning pointed to the black box over there with a solemn expression. From the moment he saw the black box, he felt a strange aura spreading in the air.
"Impossible! What's inside can't be my body! "
"My body had been destroyed a long time ago. When Viscount Webley came to Phoenix, it had been destroyed by Pastor Widno, but he didn't expect that my soul still existed. "
Sister Daisy looked at Hao Ning with a crazy look. The expression on her face seemed to say, don't try to lie to me.
"You're lying, I saw you in the cemetery behind the church that night! ...What is your purpose in bringing me here? "
Suddenly, endless doubts emerged in Hao Ning's heart. He was not sure whether Daisy was lying.
If Daisy didn't lie, then who was the body he saw? Moreover, when Webley came to Phoenix, it had been half a year since Hao Ning was arrested and sent to prison.
So who was Sister Daisy he saw the night before he was captured?
"You don't believe me? It's up to you. Our way to escape is in the center of this secret room. It's up to you whether to leave or not! "
Daisy's face turned completely gloomy, and after saying that, she walked towards the center of the secret room, where the box was, without looking back.
The only sound left in the entire secret room was the sound of tens of thousands of burning oil lamps. Hao Ning followed Daisy's footsteps with a complicated expression. He had no choice. One was to stay and wait for death, and the other was to follow Daisy.
Now that he has come this far, there is no way he can back down. Behind him is a dungeon filled with countless undead and ascended creatures!
“Daisy, I didn’t expect you’re not dead yet! And the little mouse seems to have followed here! "
At this moment, Pastor Widno's voice came from the corner of the secret room.
A dark shadow appeared in the dark corner, gradually transforming into the appearance of Pastor Vidno, wearing a white priest's robe, with a smile like a kind old man on his face.
Suddenly Hao Ning heard a vibration and a slight whistling sound in the air, which was like the sound made by the vibration of the tail fin on the arrow. In an instant, his eyes caught a black light in the corner and shot towards Daisy.
“Get down! "Hao Ning suddenly pounced and threw Daisy, who was still in a state of shock, to the ground.
Fortunately, Daisy's soul state could be touched, otherwise Hao Ning really couldn't save her. His intuition told him that the arrow was not simple!
He looked back and saw an arrow behind him sinking deeply into the ground!
"Vidno, didn't you say that the nun was dead? Now her soul is right in front of me. Are you sure this has no impact on our plan? "
A figure holding a long bow appeared next to Vidno. Hao Ning took a closer look and found that it was Viscount Webley, the target of his mission! As expected, they were in cahoots, and the other person Hao Ning saw when he was hiding in the box should be him.
“Webley, don’t worry, things will go well! You don’t need to take action to solve them! "Vidno smiled slightly and said with a smile to Webley.
Hao Ning sees all this, what is their relationship? He felt that Pastor Widno seemed to have some scruples about Webley, no, it should be said that he was in awe!
Suddenly, Daisy's shy and angry voice came to his ears: "It's time for you to get up from me! "
